## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (`make test`, `make test-race`, `make lint` pass)
- [ ] Guides edited? `make generate` run and `skills/folio` committed
- [ ] Rendered output changed? Goldens regenerated and noted in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] MCP tool names and fields unchanged, or the change is additive
- [ ] User-visible change listed under "Unreleased" in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No tokens, secrets, download links or confidential content in code, tests or logs
- [ ] Commits follow `type(scope): lowercase summary`
